The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low. Within the same priority the oldest comes first, and ticket id breaks ties. The tests matching `*Region*` pass. I didn't add a test for the new ordering or run the full suite.

The change is the `ORDER BY` in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`DataStore.java`, around line 10023). It uses the same `CASE t.priority …` ordering as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`. The closed-ticket and region filters are unchanged. Nothing is committed.
